notes.title: Pirate Flag Battle mode closing soon
notes.content:
To all One Piece Burning Blood players, thank you for enjoying Burning Blood the past few years.
 
We would like to inform you that the Pirate Flag Battle mode service will be closed on October 30th 2020.
 
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Preload the game now!
notes.content:
You can now pre-load One Piece Burning Blood ahead of this Friday's release! Learn more and join the community here: http://www.onepiece-game.com/en/one-piece-burning-blood-is-now-available-for-pre-load-on-steam/

Only a few days to go! Look forward to more news about the Steam version before Friday ;)

notes.title: Release date: September 2nd! Pre-purchase now and get bonus characters!
notes.content:
FINALLY! You've waited long enough for this: One Piece Burning Blood will launch September 2nd on Steam! Get either the standard edition or the Gold edition which includes all DLCs released on the game.

If you pre-order One Piece Burning Blood, you get acces to 3 new playable characters (Luffy Gear 4th, Kung Fu Luffy and Afro Luffy) and a customizable HUD in the colors of Luffy. 

Less than a month to go!! It's time to get hype about the PC release ;)
